verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Oneleet booking the audit itself, offering a vetted auditor network, or running an in-house audit arm. The nearby items don't qualify: the human-led pentest that feeds "into your audit", the vCISO who helps build a SOC 2 program, and a pricing-page "scope + timeline" generator that isn't tied to audit booking. These are adjacent services, not the audit-procurement capability itself.
